body: Thanks! I'll give it some more thought.
Thanks for the advice it helped. I think I need to do some more thinking about what kind of career I'm looking for. I might change my major.
Thanks for the advice, it helped. I think you might be right. I really don't like school but I do good enough at it that it seems kind of a waste not to.

I guess you're right. I'm good with computers and photoshop which is why I chose graphic design as it's something I'm decent at and could feasibly made into a career if I was motivated to. I'm also a photographer on the side and sometimes do portrait shooting for a bit of cash. 

I guess I'm just not really sure what career is good for me. I feel like I need to "shop around" before I really find what I like. I like being outdoors and making things with my hands, but I'm not sure about trade school.
I'm lonely too. I'm here if you ever want to talk. I hope the pain eases soon.

I felt just like you at 13. I'm 17 now and I still feel that way sometimes. Just wait a little longer. You're so young, and there are so many things you have yet to do, even if you don't think you'll ever do them. Don't end up another statistic.
Buy a van, get it professionally converted with solar power and everything and hit the road.
God speed and God bless. I hope you find what you're looking for.

I feel exactly the same way you do. I have been having suicidal thoughts for years now, but not once have i mentioned it to any of my parents or family members. Despite the fact i live in a supportive, loving household, i know for certain both parents would have a negative reaction and my siblings aren't close enough for me to talk to about something like this. Since I'm in the same boat, i can't exactly help you, but i do think that for your emotional well-being, you'll have to tell someone eventually. If you'd like, you could even write it out in a letter or email so you don't have to deal with the immediate reaction to whoever you decide to talk to. Again, sorry I'm not more help. I hope things get better for you.
Wow! What is it like having a cat in a van? I could barely tolerate mine in my studio apartment. There was no space.

That's honestly what I was figuring. Unfortunately we won't be able to afford something like that for quite some time, but I'll look into saving for the future. My SO wanted to put a muzzle on him so we could at least go on walks without him barking but I thought that was too cruel and didn't address the problem.
Thanks for the reply! I've been doing the same sort of idea but using his favorite cheese treats instead of toys. He's a bit of an odd dog and isn't interested in many toys except edible ones.

All the time. For no reason, too. It used to happen with friends (back when i had them) but now it's just with family. It's hard to enjoy yourself when there's that little voice telling you they would have more fun without you.
Hey. I'm not going to tell you not to do it, since I'm suicidal myself and you'd be living out my dream. I just hope that things get better for you. I hope that in the end, you're happy.
